viewing_check: Confirm species: smell a fresh scratch or cut edge (Huon pine has a strong sweet oily scent; celery-top pine does not), look at end grain for very fine tight rings, measure length, width and thickness, and check how far the split runs and whether the slab will separate. Photograph the end grain and any birdseye or figure.
